title: Slack app home / settings services layout
answers: Where is the Slack app home rendered?
Where are Slack run preferences / untagged followup settings resolved?
body:
- `backend/services/slack_app_home.py` (~2,600 lines): render side = frozen state dataclasses (`HomeViewState`, `ProjectState`, `TasksState`, `RunDefaultsState`, ...) → `render_home_view`/`render_edit_modal` via `_*_blocks`; handle side = `handle_app_home_opened`, `handle_ai_preferences_block_action`, `handle_app_home_view_submission`; `_resolve_*_state`, `_build_home_view`, `_republish_home`, `_apply_*`/`_reset_*` write prefs.
- Stats: `slack_app_home_stats.py:build_stats_state`.
- `slack_settings.py`: `AIPreferences`, `resolve_untagged_followup_mode`. `run_preferences.py`: `resolve_run_preferences`, `resolve_live_run_override` (user → workspace → central defaults). `model_catalogue.py` feeds pickers.
- Models in `backend/models.py`: `SlackThreadTaskMapping`, `SlackUserProfileCache`, `SlackSettings` (row with slack_user_id = personal; NULL = workspace fallback), `SlackChannel`. Migrations up to 0018; `ai_preferences` added then dropped (0017/0018).
